function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

Here’s a quick snapshot of the next few major festivals happening in the United States. (All dates are for 2024 unless otherwise noted.)

| Festival | Dates | Location | Type |
|----------|-------|----------|------|
| **Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival** | **April 12‑14, 2024** | Indio, California | Music & Arts |
| **Bonnaroo Music & Arts Festival** | **June 7‑10, 2024** | Manchester, Tennessee | Music & Arts |
| **Lollapalooza Chicago** | **August 2‑5, 2024** | Chicago, Illinois | Music |
| **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival** | **August 17‑19, 2024** | New Orleans, Louisiana | Jazz & Heritage |
| **South by Southwest (SXSW)** | **March 8‑17, 2024** | Austin, Texas | Film, Music, Interactive |
| **Burning Man** | **August 27‑September 4, 2024** | Black Rock Desert, Nevada | Art & Community |
| **Newport Folk Festival** | **July 20‑22, 2024** | Newport, Rhode Island | Folk Music |
| **Taste of Chicago** | **August 9‑11, 2024** | Chicago, Illinois | Food & Culture |
| **Sundance Film Festival** | **January 19‑29, 2024** | Park City, Utah | Film |
| **Comic-Con International** | **July 20‑23, 2024** | San Diego, California | Pop Culture |

### The very next big festival
- **Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival** – April 12‑14, 2024 in Indio, California.  
  *Why it’s a must‑see:* world‑renowned lineup, iconic art installations, and a vibrant festival culture. Tickets usually go on sale in late January/early February, so keep an eye on the official site.

### Quick Tips
- **Tickets:** Most festivals sell out fast. Check the official festival website or reputable ticket vendors (Ticketmaster, Eventbrite, etc.) for the latest availability.
- **Travel & Accommodation:** Book flights and lodging at least 2–3 months in advance, especially for festivals in popular destinations like Coachella or Burning Man.
- **Weather:** If you’re planning to attend a festival in the desert (Coachella, Burning Man) or in a humid city (New Orleans), consider checking the local forecast a few days before. The Open‑Meteo API can give you up‑to‑date weather data if you need it.

Let me know if you’d like more details on a specific festival, or if you’re interested in a particular type (food, film, regional, etc.). Happy planning!
